tagline: Online marketing and digital marketing courses from Azerbaijan, taught in Azerbaijani.
description: Marketing School is an online school in Baku, Azerbaijan, offering two 3-month courses taught in Azerbaijani: the Marketing Course and the Digital Marketing Course. Recorded video lessons, live Q&A twice a month, case-based homework, one-to-one mentoring and a diploma. Each course costs 99 AZN per month. Free demo: 24-hour access to the first 2 modules.
